contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #372: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity.
Audit physical-frame realization for arbitrary real smooth isotropic elasticity coefficients, preserving the actual divergence and every nonzero complex bilinear null direction.

definitions.coefficients: lambda,mu are real C-infinity functions on R^3 with mu>0 and 3*lambda+2*mu>0; m=mu, k=lambda+mu, ell=lambda+2*mu
definitions.phase: theta in C^3 is nonzero and theta dot theta=0 bilinearly; D=theta dot grad, E_tau=exp(tau*theta dot x), h=1/tau
definitions.physical_pair: U=(u,div u); the scalar component is never chosen independently for an exact physical solution
definitions.support: Transverse support is required for the formal amplitudes, not for the exact displacement or its correction
definitions.scope: Proposition prop:physical-amplitudes only; no conclusion about physical transfer, global holomorphic comparison, coefficient recovery, or global uniqueness

external_assumptions.statement: Eskin and Ralston construct invertible planar matrix frames (Lemma 1.1) and finite higher-order system complex exponential expansions (Section 2); the paragraph preceding Lemma 1.1 explicitly warns that a frame tending to the identity at spatial infinity need not exist.

external_assumptions.locator: Section 1, paragraph before Lemma 1.1 and Lemma 1.1; Section 2, equations (2.2)-(2.4)

claims.natural_statement: For every nonzero null theta and every t0 in (-2r,2r), Proposition prop:physical-amplitudes holds with three smooth constrained transport columns supported in one compact transverse set and forming a frame on D_(2r)^2 times J. Each column is the strong L2(B_(4r)) limit of the conjugated exact physical displacement-actual-divergence pair, with ||E_tau^(-1) grad U_tau||_(L2(B_(4r)))=O(tau), without coefficient smallness.

The manuscript augmented identity, normalized scalar-Laplacian principal part, all conjugated leading operators, and transport-compatibility identity hold for unrestricted smooth coefficient and amplitude jets, imposing only the bilinear null relation on theta.

For additive groups and additive maps satisfying the augmented identity, its degree-one conjugated compatibility identity, and the normal leading-operator identity, each previous compatible recursion step implies the next normal-source compatibility; finite vector residuals and normal constraints telescope for every truncation order. These are abstract conditional algebraic statements, not an analytic solvability assertion.

Every smooth constrained leading column with fixed compact transverse support can be extended to a compatible recursion of every finite order on successively smaller disks with a common limiting radius larger than 5r, preserving the same transverse support.

For every N at least 4 the compatible truncation has physical residual O(tau^(1-N)); a physical displacement correction has L2 size O(tau^(1-N)), actual conjugated divergence size O(tau^(2-N)), and h times its first divergence derivative has the same bound, yielding the claimed physical limits and weighted derivative estimate.

Smooth leading physical displacement-actual-divergence profiles necessarily satisfy the constrained rank-three transport system. Conversely every smooth constrained column on a larger planar cylinder, with compact transverse support, has exact physical realizations on B_(5r) with a single complete compatible C-infinity asymptotic expansion on B_(4r); all formal coefficients retain the same transverse support. This extends finite-order realization, not global inverse uniqueness; independent novelty and significance review remain required.

The physical-realization proof and stronger profile theorem have passed independent replay, source verification, statement-fidelity review, and a publishable-significance and verified-new-novelty assessment. This claim remains open until the host Reviewer actually performs those checks.

Under equality of the physical boundary maps, the common exterior extension and physical transfer in boundary-reduction.tex are valid. This downstream use is not certified by the physical-frame mission.

Proposition prop:transport-matching constructs a unique supported smooth comparison of constrained transport systems that is holomorphic in projective null direction. This assertion is not certified in the present mission.

Lemma lem:conic-bundle and Proposition prop:comparison-rigidity force the holomorphic comparison to be the identity, and Lemma lem:finite-type enables coefficient recovery. These assertions are not certified in the present mission.

For every bounded connected smooth domain in R^3 and real smooth coefficient pairs with mu_j>0 and 3*lambda_j+2*mu_j>0, equality of physical displacement-to-traction maps implies equality of both coefficients throughout the domain. claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace PhysicalFrame

structure CompatibilityData (A V W : Type*) [AddCommGroup A]
    [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] where
  R : A →+ V
  Rlead : A →+ V
  S : A →+ W
  Slead : A →+ W
  divV : V →+ W
  normalV : V →+ W
  normalA : A →+ W
  defect : A →+ W
  P : W →+ W
  Plead : W →+ W
  augmented : ∀ u, divV (R u) - S u = P (defect u)
  compatibility : ∀ u, divV (Rlead u) + normalV (R u) - Slead u =
    P (normalA u) + Plead (defect u)
  leading_normal : ∀ u, normalV (Rlead u) = Plead (normalA u)

section Compatibility

variable {A V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W]
variable (C : CompatibilityData A V W)

theorem normal_source_of_leading (u : A)
    (hR : C.Rlead u = 0) (hS : C.Slead u = 0) (hN : C.normalA u = 0) :
    C.normalV (C.R u) = C.Plead (C.defect u) := by
  simpa [hR, hS, hN] using C.compatibility u

theorem normal_source_of_step (previous current : A)
    (hR : C.Rlead current = -C.R previous)
    (hS : C.Slead current = -C.S previous)
    (hN : C.normalA current = -C.defect previous) :
    C.normalV (C.R current) = C.Plead (C.defect current) := by
  have balance : C.divV (C.Rlead current) - C.Slead current =
      C.P (C.normalA current) := by
    calc
      C.divV (C.Rlead current) - C.Slead current =
          -(C.divV (C.R previous) - C.S previous) := by
        rw [hR, hS, map_neg]
        abel
      _ = -C.P (C.defect previous) := by rw [C.augmented previous]
      _ = C.P (C.normalA current) := by rw [hN, map_neg]
  have combined : (C.divV (C.Rlead current) - C.Slead current) +
      C.normalV (C.R current) =
      C.P (C.normalA current) + C.Plead (C.defect current) := by
    calc
      (C.divV (C.Rlead current) - C.Slead current) + C.normalV (C.R current) =
          C.divV (C.Rlead current) + C.normalV (C.R current) - C.Slead current := by
        abel
      _ = C.P (C.normalA current) + C.Plead (C.defect current) :=
        C.compatibility current
  rw [balance] at combined
  exact add_left_cancel combined

theorem normal_source_all_orders (u : ℕ → A)
    (hR0 : C.Rlead (u 0) = 0) (hS0 : C.Slead (u 0) = 0)
    (hN0 : C.normalA (u 0) = 0)
    (hR : ∀ j, C.Rlead (u (j + 1)) = -C.R (u j))
    (hS : ∀ j, C.Slead (u (j + 1)) = -C.S (u j))
    (hN : ∀ j, C.normalA (u (j + 1)) = -C.defect (u j)) :
    ∀ j, C.normalV (C.R (u j)) = C.Plead (C.defect (u j)) := by
  intro j
  cases j with
  | zero => exact C.normal_source_of_leading (u 0) hR0 hS0 hN0
  | succ j => exact C.normal_source_of_step (u j) (u (j + 1)) (hR j) (hS j) (hN j)

theorem particular_source_tangent (u particular : A)
    (compatible : C.normalV (C.R u) = C.Plead (C.defect u))
    (normal_prescribed : C.normalA particular = -C.defect u) :
    C.normalV (-C.R u - C.Rlead particular) = 0 := by
  rw [map_sub, map_neg, C.leading_normal particular, normal_prescribed, map_neg,
    compatible]
  abel

end Compatibility

section Telescoping

variable {K V A : Type*} [CommRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
variable [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]

theorem residual_sum_telescope (h : K) (r t : ℕ → V)
    (initial : t 0 = 0) (recursion : ∀ j, t (j + 1) = -r j) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (h ^ (j + 1) • r j + h ^ j • t j)) =
      h ^ (N + 1) • r N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [initial]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, recursion N]
    simp only [smul_neg]
    abel

theorem normal_sum_telescope (h : K) (q n : ℕ → V)
    (initial : n 0 = 0) (recursion : ∀ j, n (j + 1) = -q j) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (h ^ j • n j + h ^ (j + 1) • q j)) =
      h ^ (N + 1) • q N := by
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (h ^ j • n j + h ^ (j + 1) • q j)) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (h ^ (j + 1) • q j + h ^ j • n j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact add_comm _ _
    _ = h ^ (N + 1) • q N := residual_sum_telescope h q n initial recursion N

def truncated (h : K) (u : ℕ → A) (N : ℕ) : A :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), h ^ j • u j

theorem vector_telescope (h : K) (R Rt : A →ₗ[K] V) (u : ℕ → A)
    (initial : Rt (u 0) = 0) (recursion : ∀ j, Rt (u (j + 1)) = -R (u j))
    (N : ℕ) :
    h • R (truncated h u N) + Rt (truncated h u N) =
      h ^ (N + 1) • R (u N) := by
  calc
    h • R (truncated h u N) + Rt (truncated h u N) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          (h ^ (j + 1) • R (u j) + h ^ j • Rt (u j)) := by
      simp only [truncated, map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul,
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, pow_succ']
    _ = h ^ (N + 1) • R (u N) :=
      residual_sum_telescope h (fun j => R (u j)) (fun j => Rt (u j))
        initial recursion N

theorem divergence_telescope (h : K) (q n : A →ₗ[K] V) (u : ℕ → A)
    (initial : n (u 0) = 0) (recursion : ∀ j, n (u (j + 1)) = -q (u j))
    (N : ℕ) :
    n (truncated h u N) + h • q (truncated h u N) =
      h ^ (N + 1) • q (u N) := by
  calc
    n (truncated h u N) + h • q (truncated h u N) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          (h ^ j • n (u j) + h ^ (j + 1) • q (u j)) := by
      simp only [truncated, map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul,
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, pow_succ']
    _ = h ^ (N + 1) • q (u N) :=
      normal_sum_telescope h (fun j => q (u j)) (fun j => n (u j))
        initial recursion N

end Telescoping

#print axioms normal_source_all_orders
#print axioms vector_telescope
#print axioms divergence_telescope

end PhysicalFrame
